title: Matsuyama Castle (Iyo)
geometryBasis: Six mapped building footprints, the mapped eastern and northern retaining wall, and two exact Qualla January 2009 photographs of the core castle.
sectionBasis: Three-storey tower with curved gray tile eaves and a dark timber base, joined to two-storey turrets and connecting wooden galleries above a battered granite retaining wall.
limitations: The January 2009 reconstruction covers the connected upper keep and its neighboring Tenjin turret. Lower baileys and more distant gate complexes are outside its scope.
The roof tiers, wall palette and battered stonework come from two cleared photographs. Connections, unseen wall openings and tower heights are bounded estimates.
The summit terrain was kept unchanged. Part of the stone wall follows mapped survey controls, with the remaining faces and height approximated from the photographed forecourt.
